title: A fix to lib/ leaves the plugins' copies stale
what: A fix to lib/ leaves the plugins' copies stale
why: Measured 27 Oct, change wt/owner-notes: a fixer repaired the Python 3.9 import in lib/relay_queue.py but not its copies under plugins/core/lib and plugins/front/lib; the next gate (about 15 minutes) went red only on "lib copies identical ... run bin/sync-lib-copies", and a third fix round was needed. The copies are kept by hand through bin/sync-lib-copies, which nothing runs for the agent; the gate is the first place that notices. Principle 2 (waste built into the setup) and principle 10 (the obvious way is the right way).
failing_case: Edit lib/relay_queue.py in a worktree, commit, run the quick check the worker loops on: it passes; the gate then fails on 'lib copies identical'.
pass_cases: After an edit to a file under lib/ that has plugin copies, the copies are brought up to date without the agent having to know bin/sync-lib-copies (the quiet check or the commit step does it, or the copies stop being copies).
The gate's 'lib copies identical' step stays as the safety net.
A test shows the stale copy is caught or refreshed before the gate, and fails with that step disabled.
